the shared pod setup is manifest-driven on BOTH sides: it installs and stages only what a session declares, and names no asset, relay path, destination or digest of its own

the Phase-A authorization schema carries no grant; the issuer requires one
full tracebacks for unexpected in-process driver exceptions

the layout test partitions its references: repo-relative paths must exist, declared host-local roots are checked where present and skipped where absent, and an undeclared absolute path still fails
an active tombstone may not name a declared session staging or mirror destination - checked against the four SessionSpecs, touching no path, so every environment agrees
checkpoint_tombstones.json owns the active-tombstone counts and bytes

the driver holds torch to the cgroup CPU grant via apply_cpu_budget()
a session installs every local root verify_frozen_assets.py requires, derived from the verifier and compared against declarations
a production entrypoint is a callable seam, not a main(): all orchestration is one injectable function the $0 test executes

the Stage-1 runtime deadline is READ OFF the priced envelope (base + every soft-stop reserve), so the deadline cannot drift from the price and a new reserve extends it with no edit
